title: SpeakEasy
summary: FaceTime-style rehearsal for a conversation you've been putting off. Describe the situation, edit the fictional counterpart, then talk it through on a live video call that reacts, pushes back, and can be interrupted. Built solo at MHacks 2026.
highlights: Won Best Project Built with ElevenLabs and the .Tech domain prize at MHacks 2026
Live talking-video counterpart (Tavus over Daily) voiced by ElevenLabs
Private notes never reach the model: counterpart context is built from an allowlist
About 795 unit tests plus Playwright; CI checks no secrets reach the client bundle

title: Recruiting OS
summary: Recruiting CRM, application tracker, and job-board aggregator for a student internship search. A Gmail scan keeps contacts and applications current, and reply drafts offer real open times from your calendar. Multi-tenant with bring-your-own-key AI and a no-signup demo.
highlights: Gmail scan classifies recruiting email and advances applications automatically
Reply drafts propose three open times from call hours minus calendar busy blocks
Job-board aggregator with per-job AI fit analysis and deadline extraction
Multi-tenant on Supabase; each user brings their own AI keys and is never billed for anyone else

title: Shishi
summary: Three-sided platform that funds and organizes Shabbat dinners in Tel Aviv: sponsors underwrite, hosts open their homes, attendees find a seat. One Expo codebase ships to iOS, Android, and web, with Stripe payments confirmed only by webhook.
highlights: Stripe through Supabase Edge Functions; only the webhook marks a donation paid
20 Postgres tables with row-level security on every one
Map discovery, RSVPs, potluck claiming, dinner threads, and reporting
No-account /demo mode that runs the real flows for each role

title: Course Signal
summary: Advisor-facing course-planning signal built from historical enrollment data. Adding a school is a config file, not a code change, and each institution ingests into its own database. Built for OpenAI build week, with UIUC as the demo adapter.
highlights: Institution-isolated ingestion: each school gets its own database
Adapter pattern: a school is a JSON config of sources and measurement definitions
Scoped explicitly as a planning signal, not a capacity forecast

title: Outpost
summary: Fashion shopping app that unifies one feed across 18+ retailers and surfaces the real price, with sale and price-drop alerts. A "Product DNA" tagging system drives taste-aware recommendations over about 8,000 products.
highlights: Price comparison and price-drop alerts across 18+ retailers
"Product DNA" tagging over about 8,000 products
31-table Postgres schema with row-level security throughout, plus CI and a test harness

title: kitCreator
summary: Turns any song into a playable multi-octave sampler kit. It separates stems, denoises, and slices hits into velocity-layered SFZ and DecentSampler presets for drums, bass, guitar, piano, and synth.
highlights: Source separation via Demucs, denoising via DeepFilterNet3
Automatic drum sub-stem splitting (kick/snare/hi-hat/toms/cymbals) via LarsNet
Outputs ready-to-load SFZ and DecentSampler presets

title: OpenRestore
summary: Bedside sunrise alarm and sound machine built from a smart bulb and a speaker you already own. Self-hosted and LAN-only, it replaces a $170 Hatch Restore plus a $60/year subscription for about $65 in parts.
highlights: Sunrise curves drive brightness and color temperature across a wake window
REST, WebSocket, and MQTT interfaces plus a web UI; nothing phones home
Defined behavior for DST changes, restarts, an unreachable bulb, and a dead network
Mock drivers so the whole system runs and is tested without hardware; mypy --strict
